title: Identification of potential JNK3 inhibitors through virtual screening, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation as therapeutics for Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Devi, Bharti; Jangid, Kailash; Kumar, Naveen; Kumar, Vinay; Kumar, Vinod
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、分子对接和分子动力学模拟寻找JNK3激酶抑制剂以治疗阿尔茨海默病，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a complex neurological disorder and no effective drug is available for its treatment. Numerous pathological conditions are believed to be responsible for the initiation and development of AD including c-Jun N-terminal kinases (JNKs). The JNKs are one of the enzymes from the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) family that controls the phosphorylation of various transcription factors on serine and threonine residues, and hold significant responsibilities in tasks like gene expression, cell proliferation, differentiation, and apoptosis. Since, JNK3 is primarily expressed in the brain hence its increased levels in the brain are associated with the AD pathology promoting neurofibrillary tangles, senile plaques, neuroinflammation, and nerve cell apoptosis. The current research work is focused on the development of novel JNK inhibitors as therapeutics for AD employing a structure-based virtual screening (SBVS) approach. The ZINC database (14634052 compounds) was investigated after employing pan assay interference (PAINs), drug-likeness, and diversity picking filter to distinguish molecules interacting with JNK3 by following three docking precision criteria: High Throughput Virtual Screening (HTVS), Standard Precision (SP), and Extra Precision (XP) & MMGBSA. Five lead molecules showed a better docking score in the range of -13.091 to -14.051 kcal/mol better than the reference compound (- 11.828 kcal/mol). The lead compounds displayed acceptable pharmacokinetic properties and were subjected to molecular dynamic simulations of 100 ns and binding free energy calculations. All the lead molecules showed stable RMSD and hydrogen bond interactions throughout the trajectory. The ∆G(MM/PBSA)_(total) score for the lead compounds ZINC220382956, ZINC147071339, ZINC207081127, ZINC205151456, ZINC1228819126, and CC-930 was calculated and found to be - 31.39, - 42.8, - 37.04, - 39.01, - 36.5, - 34.16 kcal/mol, respectively. Thus, it was concluded that the lead molecules identified in these studies have the potential to be explored as potent JNK3 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种复杂的神经系统疾病，目前尚无有效药物可用于治疗。多种病理状况被认为与AD的发生和发展有关，包括c-Jun N末端激酶（c-Jun N-terminal kinases, JNKs）。JNKs是丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（mitogen-activated protein kinase, MAPK）家族中的酶之一，控制多种转录因子在丝氨酸和苏氨酸残基上的磷酸化，并在基因表达、细胞增殖、分化和凋亡等任务中承担重要职责。由于JNK3主要在大脑中表达，因此其在大脑中的水平升高与AD病理相关，促进神经原纤维缠结、老年斑、神经炎症和神经细胞凋亡。当前研究工作聚焦于采用基于结构的虚拟筛选（structure-based virtual screening, SBVS）方法，开发新型JNK抑制剂作为AD治疗药物。在应用泛分析干扰（pan assay interference, PAINs）、药物相似性和多样性挑选过滤器后，对ZINC数据库（14634052个化合物）进行了研究，以通过三种对接精度标准区分与JNK3相互作用的分子：高通量虚拟筛选（High Throughput Virtual Screening, HTVS）、标准精度（Standard Precision, SP）和额外精度（Extra Precision, XP）及MMGBSA。五个先导分子显示出更好的对接分数，范围在-13.091至-14.051 kcal/mol之间，优于参考化合物（-11.828 kcal/mol）。这些先导化合物表现出可接受的药代动力学特性，并进行了100 ns的分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算。所有先导分子在整个轨迹中均显示出稳定的RMSD和氢键相互作用。计算了先导化合物ZINC220382956、ZINC147071339、ZINC207081127、ZINC205151456、ZINC1228819126和CC-930的∆G(MM/PBSA)_(total)分数，分别为-31.39、-42.8、-37.04、-39.01、-36.5、-34.16 kcal/mol。因此，结论是这些研究中识别的先导分子具有作为强效JNK3抑制剂进行探索的潜力。
